Snowmen crashing parties on freedom-loving worlds everywhere, a tariff increase on Brentaal has put imports in the can, bad year for hemmel crops on Delle II, and would you believe Serra Hailey is trying to revive her holo career?|[[Gabriel]], to [[Danna]]|<ref name="GNN3" />}}
'''Serra Hailey''' was an [[Actor/Legends|actress]] in [[Holovid/Legends|holovids]], and considered by many to be a diva. She tried to revive her career during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], maintaining her beauty, and her fan base, well after the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] founding.

==Biography==
Serra Hailey was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] [[Actor/Legends|actress]] during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|6|Hailey, Serra}}</ref> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Hailey was attempting to revive her holovid career, which made the [[NewsNet]] headlines.<ref name="GNN3" /> By [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], she had achieved her goal, starring in a number of maxi-series although some did consider her to be a little over the hill and a diva.<ref name="RFC">{{JournalCite|7|Retreat from Coruscant}}</ref>
